about: The collecta of the formulary “Quinquagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech You, O Lord, mercifully hear our prayers and guard us, released from the bonds of sins, from all adversity. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: Mercifully hear our prayers, we beseech You, Lord
guard us, released from the bonds of sins, from all adversity
